```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
#Resistance sutface for Etosha wet/dry 
# ------------------------------------------------------------

library(tidyverse)
library(terra)
library(here)

# 0. Configuring
# ------------------------------------------------------------
pop_label   <- "etosha"
years_range <- 2008:2020
 
gee_folder      <- here("data", "500m_data")
lc_dist_folder  <- here("data", "ESACCI_LCCS", "lc_dist_2")
evi_folder      <- here("data", "500m_data", "EVI data")
model_folder    <- here("outputs")
out_folder      <- here("outputs", "resistance_surfaces")
dir.create(out_folder, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
 
lc_types    <- c("cropland", "grassland", "shrubland", "tree_cover", "urban", "water_rivers")
wet_months  <- c(1:4, 11:12)
dry_months  <- c(5:10)
 
crop_extent <- ext(12.5, 25.5, -21.5, -16.5) 
target_res  <- 0.0045 # 500m in degrees 
template    <- rast(crop_extent, resolution = target_res, crs = "EPSG:4326")

# 1. Load fitted SSF modles
# ------------------------------------------------------------
 
m0_etosha_wet <- readRDS(file.path(model_folder, "m0_etosha_wet.rds"))
m0_etosha_dry <- readRDS(file.path(model_folder, "m0_etosha_dry.rds"))

# 2. Build static covariate raster (seaonal)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
build_static_stack <- function() {
 
  static_files <- c(
    core_dist  = file.path(gee_folder, "core_dist_rast_500m_new.tif"),
    fence_dist = file.path(gee_folder, "fences_dist_rast_500m.tif"),
    road_dist  = file.path(gee_folder, "roads_distance_rast_500m.tif")
  )
 
  r_list <- map(static_files, ~ project(rast(.x), template, method = "bilinear"))
  r_stack <- rast(r_list)
  names(r_stack) <- names(static_files)
 
  terrain_r <- rast(file.path(gee_folder, "terrain_rast_500m.tif"))
  terrain_r <- project(terrain_r, template, method = "bilinear")
}

# 3. Build land-cover distance stack, average across year 
# ------------------------------------------------------------
build_lc_dist_mean <- function(years = years_range) {
 
  yearly_stacks <- map(years, function(yr) {
    r_list <- map(lc_types, function(lc) {
      fp <- file.path(lc_dist_folder, paste0("dist_", lc, "_", yr, ".tif"))
      if (!file.exists(fp)) return(NULL)
      project(rast(fp), template, method = "bilinear")
    })
    r_list <- compact(r_list) 
    if (length(r_list) == 0) return(NULL)
    r <- rast(r_list)
    names(r) <- paste0(lc_types[seq_along(r_list)], "_dist")
    r
  })
  yearly_stacks <- compact(yearly_stacks)
 
  #mean across years, per land-cover type
  lc_mean <- rast(map(lc_types, function(lc) {
    layer_name <- paste0(lc, "_dist")
    layers_for_type <- rast(map(yearly_stacks, function(s) {
      if (layer_name %in% names(s)) s[[layer_name]] else NULL
    }) |> compact())
    mean(layers_for_type, na.rm = TRUE)
  }))
  names(lc_mean) <- paste0(lc_types, "_dist")
  lc_mean
}

# 4. Build EVI mean surface for given season
# ------------------------------------------------------------
 
build_evi_mean <- function(season, years = years_range) {
 
  if (season == "dry") {
    r_list <- map(years, function(yr) {
      fp <- file.path(evi_folder, paste0("evi_dry_", yr, ".tif"))
      if (!file.exists(fp)) return(NULL)
      r <- project(rast(fp), template, method = "bilinear")
      names(r) <- "evi"
      r
    })
  } else {
    # wet season files span year boundaries: evi_wet_(yr-1)_(yr).tif
    r_list <- map(years, function(yr) {
      fp <- file.path(evi_folder, paste0("evi_wet_", yr - 1, "_", yr, ".tif"))
      if (!file.exists(fp)) return(NULL)
      r <- project(rast(fp), template, method = "bilinear")
      names(r) <- "evi"
      r
    })
  }
  r_list <- compact(r_list)
  r_stack <- rast(r_list)
  evi_mean <- mean(r_stack, na.rm = TRUE)
  names(evi_mean) <- "evi"
  evi_mean
}

# 5. Build population mean surface across years
# ------------------------------------------------------------
 
build_world_pop_mean <- function(years = years_range) {
  world_pop <- rast(file.path(gee_folder, "worldPop_comb_img_500m.tif"))
  world_pop <- project(world_pop, template, method = "bilinear")
  world_pop_list <- split(world_pop, 1:nlyr(world_pop))
 
  layer_idx <- years - 1999  #matches indexing used in the SSF extraction script
  layer_idx <- layer_idx[layer_idx >= 1 & layer_idx <= length(world_pop_list)]
 
  pop_stack <- rast(world_pop_list[layer_idx])
  pop_mean <- mean(pop_stack, na.rm = TRUE)
  names(pop_mean) <- "world_pop"
  pop_mean
}

# 6. Full covariate stack for one season
# ------------------------------------------------------------
 
build_covariate_stack <- function(season) {
  static_stack  <- build_static_stack()
  lc_stack      <- build_lc_dist_mean()
  evi_stack     <- build_evi_mean(season)
  pop_stack     <- build_world_pop_mean()
 
  full_stack <- c(static_stack, lc_stack, evi_stack, pop_stack)
  full_stack
}
```
